name: filetree
description: Fork of data-goblin/claude-code-filetree (MIT) with a built-in file viewer (diff, file, markdown/mermaid preview) and per-repo branches with pull/push

activity.title: Claude activity
activity.description: Which of Claude's file activity shimmers in the tree: files read with the Read tool or Bash readers (rg, grep, find, cat) in purple, writes in orange and git actions in green

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: Icon set: auto uses Nerd Font icons when one is installed here, except in the desktop app; plain uses Unicode only

follow.title: Follow Claude
follow.description: on: the tree scrolls to what Claude reads, writes or commits. off: the view stays where you put it and only your own scrolling moves it; highlights still show.

column.title: Right column
column.description: What the right column shows by default: date (last modified) or size (files in bytes, folders as disk usage computed in the background). The header button toggles it.

accordion.title: One folder open
accordion.description: on: opening a folder closes the others, keeping only the path down to it. off: folders stay open until you close them.

root.title: Tree root
root.description: launch: the tree stays at the folder where Claude was opened, even after cd. cwd: the tree follows the session's working directory.

flightdeck.title: Flightdeck tab
flightdeck.description: on: adds a Flightdeck tab to the file viewer (context and cost, permission gate, subagents, session log; ported from scasella/claude-flightdeck) and the /flightdeck command. off: no tab, no hooks, nothing tracked.

flightdeckStart.title: Flightdeck open at start
flightdeckStart.description: on: open the Flightdeck tab when a session starts (without taking focus). off: open it with /flightdeck. Needs Flightdeck tab on.

branch.title: Branch line
branch.description: on: show the current branch, upstream and change totals above the tree. off: hide it (the git panel already shows the branch).
